names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 martie, «Sfântul Mucenic Marian diaconul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Διόδωρος ο πρεσβύτερος και Μαριανός ο διάκονος», with the rank word and the order left off.

death.note: The life of Chrysanthus and Daria, on doxologia.ro, names «împăratul Numerian (283-284)» as the emperor of the persecution in which they and the crowd in the cave died. The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year of death.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The Greek entry is one sentence and a couplet, and it is even barer than the Romanian: it gives no persecution, no emperor and no year, and does not say the cave was the martyrs' meeting place. No dates object has been written or changed from it.
